title: Roho yangu hima
chorus:
Yesu yuko mbele, Yesu yu
nyuma,
Yesu vivyo kando, walindwa
vyema.

stanzas.text:
Roho yangu hima, na taa
yako
Kaiwashe vyema, hapa si
pako;
Nguvu zote pia za duniani
Hazitakudhuru ukiamini.

Adui shetani, na nguvu
zake,
Bwana ameshinda, kwa kifo
chake;
Wewe nguvu huna, huna
kabisa,
Ndiwe mpungufu, mnyonge
hasa.

Toka na mapema, mbele
ya wote,
Omba, bisha sana, maisha
yote;
Vita vikaliko, macho ukae,
Jivike silaha, nawe
sishindwe.

Bwana Yesu ndiye kwako
mchunga,
Neno lake Bwana ndilo
upanga;
Mbingu zitakwisha, na nchi
pia,
Neno lake Bwana laendelea.
